description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rev-parse --parseopt' functionality. It sets up various test cases, defines functions to validate command-line option parsing behavior, and verifies the output of these parsing routines against expected results. The script includes testing of help messages, option parsing with different flags, special cases such as ambiguous options, and error handling.

methods.name: check_invalid_long_option
methods.description: Function to verify that invalid long options produce the correct error messages and return code.
